fields.name: 🌳 Suzano Hectare Carbon Sequestration & Oxygen Production Ledger

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, "$producer" AS hectare_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.zone_id') AS zone, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.station_id') AS station, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.net_primary_productivity_g_c_m2') AS npp, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.co2_metric_tons_yr') AS co2_tons, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.o2_metric_tons_yr') AS o2_tons, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.audit_verified') AS verified, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.audit_rationale') AS audit_proof FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'HectareCarbonOxygenYield' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 30

view.title: Certified Hectare Carbon & Oxygen Production Balance

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, "$producer" AS station_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.hectare_id') AS hectare, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.soil_moisture_pct') AS soil_moisture, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.ambient_temp_c') AS temp_c, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.understory_co2_ppm') AS co2_ppm, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.par_solar_flux_umol') AS par_flux, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.battery_mv') AS battery_mv FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'SubCanopySoilTelemetry' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 30

fields.name: 🚨 Airborne Deforestation Alarms & Canopy Dieback Incidents

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, "$producer" AS hectare_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.severity') AS severity, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.alert_type') AS threat_type, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.description') AS description, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.clearing_area_m2') AS clearing_m2, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.coordinates_lat') AS lat, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.coordinates_lon') AS lon FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'ForestThreatAlert' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20

view.title: Deforestation & Canopy Threat Incident Log (CEL Guarded)

fields.name: 🚁 Airborne Drone Canopy Optical Inspections (Lightweight VLM)

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, "$producer" AS drone_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.hectare_id') AS hectare, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.foliage_density_index') AS foliage_density, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.canopy_health_factor') AS health_factor, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.illegal_clearing_detected') AS clearing_detected, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.inspection_notes') AS notes FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'CanopyFoliageInspection' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20
